_: Rows where a stop asks more of a grade-8-or-younger reader than the four questionLoad numbers allow. Hospital Heroes is grade 2 and was the only theme this gate ever reported and the one theme it could not fail, because the rule was 'is this a derived edition' rather than 'how old is the reader'. Fifty-one of these are one decision: a four-card SEQUENCE graded as one exact permutation with no feedback is a one-in-twenty-four guess at grade 2, and dropping a card takes it to one in six. That is a decision for a person, so it is recorded rather than forced. Only shrinks: a new row fails, and a row fixed since it was recorded also fails, naming the line to delete.
